'''Earsh''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]]. In [[41 ABY]], he was present at the [[Black Hole (Fhost)|Black Hole]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Fhost]] during a [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] game. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] there when a [[Brawl in the Black Hole|deadly brawl]] broke loose after [[Khedryn Faal]] won the final hand.
